instrument.name: Box and Block Test
instrument.score: number of blocks transferred in 60 seconds, recorded separately for each hand

rmd.cost_description: Commercially produced test apparatus is sold; RMD's Not Free entry describes equipment cost rather than a demonstrated copyright license fee.

apparatus.protocol_consistency_note: Use the same apparatus geometry, block size/surface, hand order, duration and instructions for serial comparison.

measurement_properties.stroke_test_retest: RMD reports excellent test-retest reliability in stroke cohorts.
measurement_properties.mdc_scope_warning: Do not generalize one MDC value across diagnoses, chronicity, apparatus variants or populations.
measurement_properties.surface_effect_warning: RMD cites evidence that changing block surface material altered BBT performance; apparatus changes can invalidate longitudinal comparison.

rights.basis: RMD documents a standardized single-task performance procedure and commercial apparatus cost, but this review did not verify an authoritative statement placing the standardized instrument text/materials in the public domain. Rawafid therefore publishes an original recording sheet and paraphrased procedure only, without reproducing third-party manuals, layouts or branded materials.

arabic.status: Rawafid operational Arabic instructions for a non-questionnaire performance task; not represented as an official or psychometrically validated Arabic form.

guardrails: Record right and left hands separately; do not create a bilateral total.
Keep apparatus dimensions and block surfaces consistent across visits.
Do not compare a nonstandard homemade apparatus directly with published norms without documenting the deviation.
Do not interpret the BBT as fine finger dexterity; it is primarily gross manual dexterity.
Use the same hand order and instruction protocol when monitoring change.
